messages:
jordan: heads up — outgoing pages haven't been delivered for ~25m. notify-webhook is returning 200 but pager logs show nothing outgoing :rotating_light:

mike: copying logs now. do we have an example payload or header that failed?

jordan: here's an anonymized header chunk from the webhook request that looks wrong:
```
POST /v1/notify HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
X-Pager-Recipient: user-6a3f7b4c9d2e0a1...
X-Pager-Token: abcd... (truncated)
```

anna: that X-Pager-Recipient value is being truncated on our side by the header parser (noticed similar behavior in golang http lib when header > 4k). suspecting header-size enforcement on the proxy.

opsbot: incident-bot attempted 12 outbound pages during window; 0 accepted by paging gateway. Summary: attempts=12, accepted=0, last_attempt=2740012200

mike: I can confirm the ingress proxy (edge-proxy v1.3.2) has a default header size limit. pushing a quick config bump to staging now. patch: `nginx proxy_buffer_size /large-client-headers on` — testing.

jason: rolling restart of notify-webhook to pick up proxy change. doing canary on two pods first.

sara: manual escalation started via PagerDuty web UI for the impacted alerts (customers with active incidents). @oncall please watch for dup pages. :white_check_mark:

mike: staging looks good, headers preserved. applying to prod edge-proxy (low-risk config). will follow with immediate verification of outgoing pages.

incident-bot: outbound gateway accepted pages after 2740012458. 8 pages accepted, 4 failed (in-flight).

jordan: confirmed receipts from PD for the accepted pages. thanks. keeping incident open until we verify no other suppressed routes.

anna: root cause: edge-proxy header-size default + large encoded metadata in X-Pager-Recipient (we added long routing metadata recently). Action items:
- short-term: increase header size and restart proxy (done)
- medium-term: move long metadata into request body / use compact encoding (PR planned)
- add monitoring: alert when outgoing page acceptance ratio < 95% over 5m

sara: filing postmortem template and scheduling 30m retro in #incidents-postmortems. tagging eng-infra and eng-oncall.

jason: deploying the body-encoding PR in a canary branch later today; will coordinate with PD escalation owners in case of churn.

mike: note for follow-up — add a synthetic that sends a max-sized header payload to validate proxy limits in CI.

jordan: thanks everyone. good catch. closing incident once the monitoring alert rule lands and the PD dup-check is confirmed. :teamwork:
